newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated says Litho purchase terminated.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated says Litho purchase terminated.

text.p: Consolidated Graphics Inc said Wednesday its letter of intent for the proposed acquisition of Litho Industries Inc has been terminated by mutual agreement.
The company did not give a reason for the termination.
Consolidated also said its total annualized run-rate revenues had risen to over $175 million.

"In the coming months, we expect to realize additional benefits from our most recent acquisitions and add more high quality printers to an already strong group of operating companies," said Joe Davis chairman and chief executive. "The annualized run-rate revenues of our 19 companies now exceed $175 million, an increase of $75 million for the year."
Consolidated Graphics earned $0.25 per share in the 1997 fourth quarter, compared to $0.10 per share a year ago.
Consolidated Graphics reported sales for all of fiscal 1997 of $144.1 million, an increase of 69 percent over 1996.
The company attributed strong sales growth to its acquisition program, in which ten companies were acquired over the past 15 months, and to consistently strong internal growth rates.
